notes.title: Welcome to Rogue Ottoman
notes.notes:
[b]Hey there everyone![/b]

We are still working on the Rogue Ottoman game, which we have been developing for a while. We are excited to make this announcement.

Our game will offer you a theme that has not been tried before and will support it with a satisfying gameplay and will bring you a nice content.
 
Rogue Ottoman will include many systems in the classic action rogue-lite theme, as well as different gameplay systems. And it also contains a story that will interest you. The development process of the game will last until April 2024 and we will continue to work to keep our page up to date in this process. We are currently preparing for a demo that we want to publish on the Steam page. Very soon we will start to tell you the story of the game and you will also see the content coming to the game in this process.

We are open to every comment for Rogue Ottoman and we hope that a nice game that you will love will emerge in the process.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2639360/Rogue_Ottoman/
